candidates.source_name: ARBK — Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve (Kosovo Business Registration Agency), official portal
candidates.why_relevant: Sole statutory business registry for Kosovo, under the Ministry of Trade and Industry. Definitive enumeration of legal entities: banks, microfinance institutions, insurers, payment/fintech companies, and — critically for a vendor lens — locally registered subsidiaries and branches of POS/payments suppliers, with owners, officers, activity codes and registration dates.
candidates.access_status: public search interface; ASP.NET postback forms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted name/NUI lookups via the public search; for bulk work prefer the mirrored open datasets rather than hammering the government portal
queries_used: ARBK Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve regjistri i kompanive Kosovë

candidates.source_name: ARBK Open (arbk.org) — open mirror of the Kosovo business registry
candidates.why_relevant: Self-described largest open source of Kosovo business data; lets you search registrations, owners, activities and statistics without fighting the government portal's postback forms. Ideal for bulk actor enumeration by NACE/activity (financial intermediation, IT services) and for owner-graph snowballing.
candidates.legal_status: third-party republication of public registry data; verify ToS before bulk scraping

negative_findings.description: Searching in Serbian for a Kosovo-based Serbian-language business chamber or member registry (e.g. a Serb business association in North Mitrovica) returned only Serbia-proper institutions — Privredna komora Srbije, APR, and the Serbian Register of Chambers — plus a KoSSev news item about the Kosovo Chamber joining the ICC.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Kosovo-specific Serbian-language association or membership registry identified in this pass; Serbian-language coverage of my cell is currently empty.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Serb-majority north has its own business and banking arrangements; leaving it unmapped means the actor universe is incomplete and any 'complete list of institutions' claim would be wrong.

negative_findings.description: Queries in Albanian and English for a Kosovo fintech or payment-institutions association returned no such body. STIKK (ICT) and ICK (incubator) are the closest proxies; SHBK covers banks only.
negative_findings.result_summary: No 'Shoqata e Fintech-ut' or payment-institution association appears to exist for Kosovo.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Non-bank payment institutions and e-money issuers have no membership pointer of their own, so they must be enumerated from the central bank's licence register and ARBK activity codes instead.

negative_findings.description: The Insurance Association of Kosovo (Shoqata e Sigurimeve të Kosovës) is well attested — founded 2002, 14 members — but no first-party website was located; only D&B, news and Facebook profiles surfaced. The speculative domain ask-ks.org was not confirmed and is NOT asserted as real.
negative_findings.result_summary: Association exists; canonical URL unknown after two sq queries.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without the first-party site there is no authoritative member list or publication feed for the insurance sector; the roster has to be reconstructed from BKS and the central bank register.

negative_findings.description: AmCham Kosovo, OEGJK/KDWV and AKB all publicise member counts (100+ activities, ~200 companies, 9,500+ members across 28 associations) but no machine-readable member directory was found in search results for any of them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Counts are public; lists are not, at least not via search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Member counts cannot substitute for named entities; these chambers may require direct requests, event-page mining, or logo-wall extraction to yield actual actor names.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetches of bankassoc-kos.com and amik.org both returned HTTP 403. Both domains are indexed by search engines and had content summarised in results, so these are treated as bot-defended-but-live, not dead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two of the highest-value pointers in this cell need browser-grade collection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive HTTP collector would silently drop the two most important association registries in the cell and produce a false negative on the bank and microfinance actor lists.

brief: Kosovo's association/registry layer is small, concentrated and mostly Albanian-language: SHBK (nine member banks), AMIK (microfinance), the insurance association plus the Kosovo Insurance Bureau, STIKK for the ICT vendor base, and a fragmented chamber landscape (OEK, DHTIK, AKB, plus AmCham, OEGJK and a Turkish chamber). ARBK is the authoritative enumerator of every legal entity and is far more accessible through its open mirrors — arbk.org, OpenCorporates, OCCRP Aleph, Open Data Kosovo's scraper — than through its own ASP.NET portal. The two highest-value association registries, bankassoc-kos.com and amik.org, both returned 403 to automated fetching and need browser-grade collection; they are bot-defended, not dead. The cell's two real holes are Serbian-language coverage of the north, where nothing was found, and non-bank payment/e-money institutions, which have no association of their own and must be enumerated from the central bank register and ARBK activity codes.
